name: mf_fno_transfer_2m
description: Parameter-matched ablation of mf_fno_transfer: identical transfer-learning MF-FNO (pretrain on LF, fine-tune on HF) and identical backbone, width reduced 64->48 (GroupNorm needs width divisible by 8) giving ~2.67M params, close to the in-tree fno_coreg_residual (2.37M) / fno_mf_stack (2.35M) and slightly ABOVE them so the control is conservative (baseline is not handicapped). Isolates transfer MECHANISM from raw CAPACITY.
paper: param-matched control for Lyu et al. 2023 (arXiv:2304.06972) / GCS MF-FNO (arXiv:2308.09113)
